permissions.intro: Global permissions apply to all of BuggyWuggy, not to one project. They are granted to groups. Members of a group that gains or loses a permission are logged out and get the change at their next login — that includes you, if you are a member.

help.ADMINISTER: Manage users, groups and global permissions; archive, delete and re-key projects; change the settings of every project.
help.CREATE_PROJECT: Create new projects. The creator becomes the project lead and administrator.
help.BROWSE_USERS: Find users and groups by name, e.g. to filter issues or to fill project roles.

user.search: Search by name, username or e-mail
user.systemAdminHelp: Has every permission everywhere, and can manage other system administrators.
user.createHelp: New users are added to the users group.
user.activeHelp: Inactive users cannot log in, but their name stays on their issues and comments.
user.passwordSet: The password of {{name}} has been set.
user.setPasswordHelp: The user is logged out everywhere and must log in with the new password.
user.groupsHelp: When membership of a group with global permissions changes, the user is logged out and gets the new permissions at the next login.

group.name: Name
group.builtInHelp: Built-in groups cannot be renamed or deleted.
group.deleteConfirm: Delete the group {{name}}? Its members are kept, but lose the permissions and roles the group gave them.

settings.title: Project settings
settings.keyHelp: Changing the key changes all issue keys; the old keys keep working.
settings.keyAdminOnly: Only BuggyWuggy administrators can change the key.
settings.defaultAssigneeHelp: Who new issues are assigned to when nobody is chosen.
settings.archivedNotice: This project is archived: its issues can be viewed, but nothing can be changed. Ask a BuggyWuggy administrator to restore it.
settings.archivedNoticeAdmin: This project is archived: its issues can be viewed, but nothing can be changed. Restore it under Details to make changes.
settings.archiveHelp: Hides the project from the project list and makes it read-only. Can be undone.
settings.unarchiveHelp: Makes the project visible and editable again.
settings.deleteHelp: Deletes the project with all its issues, comments and attachments. Cannot be undone.
settings.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes the project with all its issues, comments, attachments and history.
settings.deleteTypeKey: Type the project key {{key}} to confirm
settings.componentsIntro: Components are parts of the product, for example "Backend" or "Documentation".

component.name: Name
component.deleteConfirm: Delete the component {{name}}? It is removed from all issues.
component.leadRequired: Choose a lead to assign issues to the component lead.

settings.versionsIntro: Versions are releases of the product. Their order here is the order in which they are offered.

version.name: Name
version.deleteConfirm: Delete the version {{name}}? It is removed from all issues.
version.datesInvalid: The release date cannot be before the start date.

settings.rolesIntro: Roles decide what people may do in this project: Users can see and create issues, Developers can work on them, Administrators can change these settings. Add groups or individual users to a role.
